extension.summary: Rivulet: watch Stremio-protocol catalogs, addons and streams in Kodi
extension.description: Rivulet is a Kodi client for the Stremio addon protocol: browse Discover and Search catalogs, install community Stremio addons from a manifest URL, resolve streams and play them back through an embedded or remote stremio-server-go streaming server, and optionally sync your addon collection with your Stremio account.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, index or provide any media content. It is a client for third-party Stremio addons that you install yourself.
extension.news: v0.6.1: - Fix: stopping a stalled stream still took the best part of a minute before Kodi responded. 0.5.6 blamed the wrong network timeout; the one that actually governs it is the low-speed window Kodi applies to playback reads, which a stalled stream sits in at zero bytes per second until it expires. It is now Kodi's own default instead of triple it, taking a stop from around 57 seconds to around 20. Not instant - an add-on cannot interrupt Kodi's own reader - but a third of the wait. NOTE: if you already installed Rivulet's advancedsettings.xml it is never overwritten, so edit curllowspeedtime to 20 yourself, or delete the file and re-install it from Settings. v0.6.0: - New: add-ons are now queried all at once instead of one after another, and the stream list opens as soon as the first one answers rather than waiting for the slowest. If you run several stream add-ons this removes whichever is slowest or unreachable from the wait; if you run only one, there is nothing to overlap and you will not notice a difference. Remaining results drop in live while you are already browsing, with a line telling you more are still on the way, and the row you have highlighted stays highlighted as the list re-orders around it. - Fix: an add-on still waiting on its timeout could keep Rivulet running in the background after you had already left the stream list, which could hold up Kodi. Those lookups are now abandoned the moment you walk away. v0.5.8: - Fix: with "play next episode automatically" enabled, stopping an episode yourself started the next one anyway. Stopping is you saying you are done, so it now returns to the stream list and stays there; the next episode only auto-plays when an episode actually finishes. The same applied to stopping an episode that had been auto-played - that no longer keeps the chain going either. - New: Rivulet now tells you when it has been updated. Kodi installs add-on updates silently, so the first time you open Rivulet after a new version lands you get a brief notification saying which version you are now on. It appears once per update, never on a fresh install. v0.5.7: - Fix: Rivulet would start playing a torrent as soon as the first half-megabyte arrived, even when the swarm was far too slow to keep up - so playback began and then stalled seconds later. It now checks the measured download speed first: if the source cannot fill the rest of your configured buffer almost immediately, it keeps buffering (showing live speed and peer count, cancellable) instead of starting into a stall. Fast sources still start just as quickly as before, and a slow-but-working source still plays rather than buffering forever. v0.5.6: - Fix: pressing stop on a stalled torrent could leave Kodi frozen for up to three minutes. Rivulet's recommended advancedsettings.xml doubled Kodi's network timeout, and Kodi waits for the reader to give up before it can finish stopping. That timeout is back to Kodi's own value, with one retry instead of two, so stopping a stuck stream is now bounded at about a minute in the worst case. Patience with slow-but-moving torrents is unaffected - that is a separate setting, left as it was. NOTE: if you already installed Rivulet's advancedsettings.xml, it is never overwritten - edit it yourself, or delete it and re-install it from Settings, to pick this up. - Fix: the log claimed "pre-buffer complete" when playback had in fact started early on a partly-filled buffer, which was misleading in exactly the logs where it mattered - a stream stalling seconds after it started. It now says which of the two happened. v0.5.5: - Fix: Rivulet's icon, fanart and screenshot gallery were missing in Kodi's own Add-ons browser when installing from the Rivulet repository. The repository was publishing those images to different paths than the ones the add-on declares, so Kodi asked for them and got nothing back. The screenshots added in 0.4.20 should finally be visible. - Improved: the metadata cache now keeps itself under a fixed size budget rather than a fixed number of titles. A TV series entry is far bigger than a film's (it lists every episode), so the old limit could let the cache grow to a few megabytes and rewrite all of it each time a title was cached - the opposite of what it was there for on SD-card and eMMC installs. v0.5.4: - Fix: seeder counts were missing from nearly every Torrentio result, and the few that did appear were usually wrong. Torrentio states the count before the file size, which Rivulet was not reading, so it fell back to guessing at other numbers in the release name. It now reads Torrentio's own marker: the count is correct on every row, and sorting by seeders works properly. Checked against 100 live Torrentio results. v0.5.3: - Improved: a long stream list now uses about half the memory it did, and writes about half as much to storage. Each row carries a hidden copy of its stream details, which is now compressed - roughly 200KB less on a title that returns several hundred sources. Best felt on TV boxes and SD-card installs, where storage writes are the scarce resource. - Improved: Kodi 19 loads one less module on every navigation. v0.5.2: - Improved: every screen opens faster. Rivulet used to load its whole network stack on each navigation, even on screens that never go online - the Home screen now loads a fifth of the code it did before, and the stream list, player and catalog views open around four times sooner. Most noticeable on TV boxes, Raspberry Pi and other low-power devices. - Improved: long stream lists appear sooner - the text tidy-up that runs over every row is about eight times quicker, which adds up over the hundreds of sources a popular title returns. - Improved: stepping through a show's seasons no longer re-downloads that title's details once per season; they are reused for a few minutes. - Improved: the poster coverflow scrolls more smoothly - the background image is no longer re-sent to the skin on keypresses that do not change the highlighted title. - Improved: Rivulet re-reads its add-on list and saved state from disk far less often, writes its playback progress more compactly, and the background service no longer touches the disk every couple of seconds while nothing is playing - less wear on SD cards and internal storage. v0.5.1: - New: the stream list's second line now describes the file itself - audio format and channel layout, languages, bitrate, release group and tracker - instead of repeating the add-on name. - New: debrid sources say whether they are ready to play: the service code shows green when the file is cached and orange with "DL" when it still has to be downloaded first. Torrentio, Comet, StremThru and every built-in AIOStreams format are recognised. - New: Dolby Vision profile markers (P5/P7/P8, FEL, MEL, BL+RPU, Hybrid) and editions like IMAX, Extended or REPACK now show on the row, so a native DV remux can be told apart from a re-mapped conversion without starting playback first. - Improved: the add-on name moved to the end of the first line, and is dropped entirely when every source came from the same add-on. v0.5.0: - New: the next episode now plays automatically when one finishes, with a cancellable countdown, preferring a release from the same group as the episode you just watched. Turn it off, or change the countdown, under Playback. - New: what you watch is now written back to your Stremio account - progress, resume position and watched state - and Rivulet offers to resume where you left off. Progress is kept locally too, so resume works logged out. - New: RAR/ZIP/7z/TAR/TGZ, NZB and FTP streams now play through the streaming server instead of silently failing. - Fix: magnet links whose info hash is in Base32 form no longer produce an unplayable link, and percent-encoded trackers are decoded before use. - Fix: the player's info panel no longer reads "Not available" - it now shows the title's own description, falling back to the release/size/seeders of the file playing. - Improved: streams that can only be opened in the Stremio app now say so instead of failing as "no playable stream". - Improved: seeder counts in the stream list are marked with a triangle instead of the old "S50" prefix, and subtitle add-ons' own labels are carried through. v0.4.22: - Fix: while a stream was playing, play/pause and the on-screen playback controls did nothing until you backed out of the addon and returned to the video - every Rivulet screen is a Kodi modal dialog, and Kodi sends all input to the topmost dialog rather than to the player. All open screens now step aside when playback starts and come back exactly where you left them when it ends. - Fix: the player's info panel showed "Not available" with a placeholder image instead of the title and poster of what you picked. - Improved: torrent streams now report their real file name to Kodi, so the correct media type is used instead of leaving Kodi to guess. v0.4.21: - Fix: 32-bit Android and Android TV devices (e.g. Chromecast with Google TV) were detected as an unknown CPU architecture (armv8l) and the server-binary download failed with "No release asset for this platform". - Fix: on Android the addon now says up front that the embedded streaming server cannot run there and to point Server URL at a server running elsewhere, instead of failing with a confusing download error. - Improved: a downloaded server binary is now verified to be executable, and the "no release asset" message now names the detected platform. v0.4.20: - New: README and the project site now show a real screenshot gallery of the current UI, generated by a new scripts/capture_screenshots.py (drives a running Kodi over its JSON-RPC socket). - New: Kodi's own Add-ons browser now shows real screenshots for Rivulet instead of empty placeholders. v0.4.19: - Fix: quitting Kodi while the streaming-server binary was still auto-downloading no longer hangs shutdown until the download finishes. - Fix: a crashed embedded server now releases its log file immediately on restart. - Improved: stream resolution and Stremio account requests now reuse HTTP connections - snappier browsing and playback start on slow devices. v0.4.18: - Fix: Home screen's second line per row (e.g. "Browse catalogs from your installed addons" under Discover) was a hardcoded English literal that never translated, even when the row's own main label correctly did (e.g. "Scopri" in Italian). Now localized like every other string. v0.4.17: - New: Rivulet's UI is now translated - Italian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean and Arabic, on top of English. The language follows Kodi's own interface-language setting automatically (Settings > Interface > Language), with no addon setting to configure. v0.4.16: - New: the embedded stremio-server's full configuration is now exposed under Settings (5 new sections: BitTorrent, Server resources, Server proxy, Server add-ons, Server diagnostics) - peer/tracker/encryption tuning, memory caps, idle-torrent timeout, proxy relay, Bitmagnet/Torznab indexers, DLNA casting and more, instead of only being controllable via environment variables. Changing any of them restarts the embedded server automatically, same as the existing Server URL setting already does. v0.4.15: - Fix: pressing Back from search results fell straight through to the Home menu instead of returning to the previous screen (Search had no screen of its own to return to). - New: Search now remembers past queries (clearable) and lets you re-run one instead of retyping - Kodi's on-screen keyboard has no live-typing autocomplete, so this history list is the closest equivalent. v0.4.14: - Fix: Settings > Account had no way to log in - clicking "Sync addons now" while logged out just said "Login to Stremio" with nowhere to do it. Added dedicated Login/Logout buttons there. - Fix: the Kodi repository add-on used a schema Kodi 21+ no longer supports ("no directory matching" error) and could not be installed/updated on Kodi 21. v0.4.13: - New: a Kodi add-on repository (repository.rivulet) is now published, so Rivulet can update itself automatically instead of needing a manual zip reinstall for every release. - New: a project site with install instructions and docs is published to GitHub Pages. v0.4.12: - New: Library and Add-ons now have their own custom screens (no more dropping to the classical Kodi directory). - New: Add-ons screen lets you install from a manifest URL and remove addons directly. - New: the streams screen shows year, runtime, rating and genres, and drops repeated provider names when every source is from the same addon. - New: Discover's poster wall fades softly at both edges instead of a hard cut. - Fix: backing out of a nested screen (Discover, a title's sources, ...) now correctly returns to the previous screen instead of sometimes jumping back to the Home menu. v0.4.11: - Fix: playback now takes the screen immediately - video no longer starts hidden behind the menu until you press Back. - Fix: stopping playback no longer briefly spawns a duplicate Home screen. v0.4.10: - Fix: an addon that's briefly unavailable no longer freezes the UI - streams/search now query addons in parallel instead of one at a time. - Fix: an expired Stremio session now prompts a clean re-login instead of silently failing. - Fix: installed addons' info now refreshes automatically instead of going stale forever. - Fix: a rare crash could leave a screen stuck open; screens now always close properly. - Fix: two addon actions running at the same time could silently lose one of them - now safely retried. - Security: the streaming server binary download now always verifies its integrity before installing. v0.4.9: - Fix: logging in no longer wipes addons you installed while logged out - addon sync is now a proper two-way sync. - New: Settings > Account > "Sync addons now" to force and confirm a sync. - New: a loading spinner (with progress and cancel) now shows during Search/Discover/Streams lookups instead of a frozen screen. - Fix: the app icon's logo graphic is now properly centered. v0.4.8: - Fix: movies no longer show a pointless "Play" step - pick a movie and go straight to sources. - Fix: a stray "[/B]" no longer shows on the top stream row. - Fix: Library and Add-ons no longer fail to open from the new Home. - Home menu got icons, short descriptions and a login-status line. v0.4.7: - New: a custom, non-standard Home/Discover/Search/Detail/Streams UI (Library/Add-ons/Settings still classic). - Showcase now reports errors (notification + log) instead of failing silently.
